name: Shimaisou
source:
On a winter day, my younger sister's body plummeted into the courtyard of Kagome Seishin Girls Academy.

A sanctuary to young girls, a paradise for lambs.
Like this place, my sister closed herself off from the world long ago, drifting in space until gravity brought her down.

She escaped with her life intact, but fell into a coma.

And now I, Hoomuku Tooku,
and my friend Mizuumi Shizuku,
are looking for the reason that my sister fell --

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE150181.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
冬日里，妹妹的尸体坠落到戈薇西神女子学园的院子里。

年轻女孩的庇护所，羔羊的天堂。
就像这个地方一样，我的姐姐很早就与世隔绝，在太空中漂流，直到重力将她击落。

她毫发无伤地逃脱了，但陷入了昏迷。

现在我，Hoomuku Tooku，
还有我的朋友水海雫，
正在寻找我妹妹摔倒的原因——

[编辑自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE150181.html]DLSite English[/url]]
